source: DAOx (Rhodotorula gracilis D-amino-acid oxidase) single-substrate (D-Ala) catalytic-activity DMS (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.15846928, Fitness_scores_dataset.xlsx, Missense sheet); yeast-surface-display saturation mutagenesis, H2O2->fluorescence FACS-seq activity fitness + SEPARATE expression fitness + per-position distance-to-catalytic-site; single substrate, single mechanism, no perturbation arm, no design generator
cannot_claim: single substrate (D-Ala) chosen for single-mechanism; multi-substrate specificity is a separate claim (substrate identity would leak)
expression SEPARATELY measured -> put in baseline; test is activity BEYOND expression (distinct from ProteinGym expression-confounded tolerance)

single-protein DMS: NOT family holdout -> LEAVE-POSITION-OUT (whole positions to folds) so position identity cannot be memorized; structure features (distance-to-catalytic-site, local context) must transfer across held-out positions
distance-to-catalytic-site is a per-position structural feature from the paper; local context reconstructed from WT sequence (position->WT residue map)
